_doc: Faithful capture of the owner's REAL Google Sheet, in the Google Sheets REST v4 values shape (majorDimension=ROWS, first row is the header). The browser googleSheets.ts reader returns exactly this; the pure backend parser (portfolio/transactions.py) maps the descriptive headers to canonical fields, strips $/comma money, parses day-first slash + month-name dates, and lower/upper-cases as needed. Shared by the US1/US2/US3 unit + contract tests. Computed columns (Total Value / Current Price / Market Value) are spreadsheet formulas that MUST be ignored.
